He also defends a previous week's khutba by Mahmood Abib, citing Abraham's request to have his heart assured, and returns to his own eight years of resistance to announcing his messengership, the test he now reads in Sura 17:94, and the case of Kassim Ahmad in Malaysia as a believer who accepted everything else but not the announcement. Related recording: the Dawn Prayer segment also appears appended to "16 - Essentials of Submission (Islam)" in this collection.
